title: 一封信怎么寄到
subtitle: 写好地址，它自己会走
character: wearing a postal blue t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with thick clean outlines and flat fills in ink blue, postal red and warm off-white, simple chunky shapes, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
奶奶住在很远的地方。
妈妈说，
写封信寄给她吧。
我把信放进邮筒，
它就不见了。它去哪儿了？
pages.scene: The little boy drops a letter into a street postbox, standing on tiptoe, watching it disappear.

pages.zh:
信封上要写清楚「地址」。
收信人的地址写在中间，
自己的写在左上角，
右上角贴邮票。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one envelope on a cream background with three marked areas: a small square at the top right, a short block at the top left, and a longer block in the middle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地址要从大写到小。
先写城市，
再写街道，
最后写门牌号。
这样才找得到。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three nested rectangles on a cream background, each inside the previous one, from largest to smallest. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
邮筒里的信
每天会被收走，
装进大袋子，
送到分拣中心。
pages.scene: One postbox on a cream background with a mail sack beside it, drawn plainly. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
分拣中心很大。
机器读信封上的地址，
按城市分成一堆一堆，
每堆去一个方向。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one box on the left of a cream background with four arrows leaving it toward four separate piles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
邮票是付钱的凭证。
贴了邮票，
就表示这一路的运费
已经付过了。
pages.scene: One postage stamp on a cream background with a small decorative border, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
信可能坐卡车，
可能坐火车，
很远的还要坐飞机。
一站一站地往前走。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three vehicles in a row on a cream background connected by two arrows: a truck, a train and a plane. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
到了奶奶那个城市，
再分到她那条街，
最后交给
负责那条街的邮递员。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large area on a cream background divided into smaller and smaller sections, with one final small section marked. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
邮递员骑着车，
按门牌号一家一家送。
有的塞进门口的信箱，
有的要请人签收。
pages.scene: One postal bicycle with a full basket on a cream background, beside a row of small letterboxes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
美国很多人家
门口有个信箱，
上面有一面小红旗。
旗子竖起来，
意思是有信要寄走。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one roadside mailbox on a cream background with a small flag on its side, drawn in the raised position. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以地址写错，
信就找不到人。
写清楚、写工整，
它才能
一路走到奶奶手里。
pages.scene: One envelope on a cream background with neat clear blocks of writing in the address area. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
过了一个星期，
奶奶打电话来了。
她说信收到了。
我的那封信，
真的自己走到了她家。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a telephone to his ear, smiling widely, very pleased.
